meta.description: Guidances extraites des communiqués de résultats (8-K Item 2.02, SEC)

guidances.libelle: Croissance du chiffre d'affaires de base (non-GAAP) hors revenus respiratoires
guidances.citation: For the fourth quarter 2026, the Company anticipates that non-GAAP core revenue excluding respiratory revenue will increase in the 4.0% to 5.0% range year-over-year.

guidances.libelle: Croissance du chiffre d'affaires de base
guidances.citation: We expect respiratory revenue to be an approximately 150 basis point headwind, resulting in core revenue growth of approximately 3.0%.

guidances.libelle: Bénéfice net dilué ajusté par action
guidances.citation: For full year 2026, the Company is increasing its full year adjusted diluted net earnings per common share guidance to a range of $8.57 to $8.62 versus previous guidance of $8.45 to $8.60.
